payload.title: Qualify affiliate programs and exact disclosed link routing
payload.goal: Enable only approved, eligible commercial referrals while preserving useful non-affiliate guidance.
payload.owner_role: Designated Windows release parent assigns one admitted implementation owner; separate exact-source reviewer; existing scheduled operator retains integration/effect ownership
implementation_steps: Recheck official program terms and prepare owner-ready applications using existing brand/account assets; record geography, traffic/content restrictions, commission definition, attribution, threshold, link rules and agreement revision.
Keep identity/tax/payout/agreements/CAPTCHA/2FA as exact non-delegable gates; never assert approval from a public program landing page.
Store approval evidence reference and validated exact tracking destination; permit only approved product, geography and page placement, with clear near-link disclosure.
Remove or suspend affected routing on approval expiry, changed terms, wrong destination or stale source confidence; retain editorial links/guide utility where eligible.
Check that rankings derive from fit evidence and user needs, never commission rate; no cloaking or route transformation without exact-term permission.
deliverables: link registry and disclosure test receipt
tests: Wrong geography, changed terms hash, unsupported link format or missing near-link disclosure fails release.
Review exact redirect/destination chain and manufacturer model; no test purchase or fabricated approval is required.

review.identity_requirement: Reviewer-authored record with actual reviewer identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model qualification is required for runtime/release acceptance and is not supplied by this plan.
review.exact_source: Bind immutable implementation commit, task/spec hash, artifact hashes, executed test receipts and any destination receipt. New source invalidates prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two targeted repair/review cycles; unresolved findings become a linked blocked task, preserving attempts.

acceptance: Each active affiliate link has current approval/terms/account/product/page evidence and receiving-link verification.
With no approval, checker and non-affiliate guides remain releasable and commission capability stays explicitly disabled.
payload.rollback: Deactivate only affected commercial links and restore editorial destinations; retain approval history and commission reconciliation.
payload.next_eligible_action: Reverify official terms and prepare application data without accepting agreements or submitting identity information.

estimate.assumptions: New planning range for admitted implementation and bounded review; reuses evidenced assets; excludes observation waiting, non-delegable account work and shared-platform implementation. Not a replacement for historical Jira estimates or measured actuals.
estimate.dependency_risk: Program approval/identity terms are external gates and may not be obtainable within an implementation sprint.
